chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id al-Hashimi narrated to us. He said: Furat ibn Ibrahim al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Ma'mar narrated to us. He said: Ahmad ibn Ali al-Ramli narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Musa narrated to us. He said: Ya'qub ibn Ishaq al-Maruzi narrated to us. He said: 'Amr ibn Mansur narrated to us. He said: Isma'il ibn Aban narrated to us from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir from his father from Abu Harun al-'Abdi from Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari. He said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Ali ibn Abi Talib is the foremost of my nation in submission, the most knowledgeable of them, the most correct of them in religion, the best of them in certainty, the most forbearing of them, the most generous of them of hand, and the boldest of them in heart -- and he is the Imam and the Caliph after me.

key_terms.أَقْدَمُ أُمَّتِي سِلْماً: The foremost of my nation in submission: Ali was the first to embrace Islam
key_terms.الْإِمَامُ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ بَعْدِي: The Imam and the Caliph after me: explicit declaration of Ali's succession

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about the virtues of Ali ibn Abi Talib in al-Amali of Sheikh al-Saduq?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) declared the comprehensive superiority of Imam Ali (AS) over the entire Muslim community in seven qualities -- submission, knowledge, religious correctness, certainty, forbearance, generosity, and bravery -- and explicitly designated him as the Imam and Caliph after himself. This was narrated through a chain from Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari in the second assembly recorded by Sheikh al-Saduq.
